title: plugin-describe
description: The output of a describe call: who the plugin is and the digest of what it provides.

id.description: Plugin id; equals the id in the manifest.

kind.description: Plugin kind; equals the kind in the manifest.

version.description: Plugin version; equals the version in the manifest.

capabilities_digest.description: Digest of the provides object of the manifest, by the rules of digest/v1.

transport.description: How the plugin talks to the host.
